meta.descripcion: What Rumbia is, how it helps travelers and agencies plan full trips, and what it costs.

hero.titulo: Plan extraordinary trips with clarity, control, and professionalism
hero.texto: From your next personal getaway to commercial client management for travel agencies. Forget chaotic spreadsheets, scattered notes, and endless quotes.
hero.probarSinCuenta: Try the generator without an account

dosMundos.titulo: Designed for travelers, built for agencies
dosMundos.texto: Two experiences, perfectly tailored. Learn what each profile can do and its conditions:

viajeros.texto: Ideal for planning your vacation, a couples getaway, or a group trip with friends:

puntos.texto: Add up transportation, lodging, meals, and miscellaneous expenses in one unified budget.
Day-by-day activity proposals tailored to your interests and preferred pace.
Weather forecast and visualization of your destinations, right on your phone.
Jump to Skyscanner, Booking, or Airbnb with your dates and destination pre-filled.

limites.sinLimite: Saved trips, notes, expenses, and manual calculations with no limit at all.

agencias.texto: Professional-grade tools to build quotes, close clients, and operate as a team:

puntos.texto: Apply fixed or percentage commissions and calculate your profit automatically.
Upload your logo, name, and contact info; they print on the client's official letterhead.
Choose whether to show the breakdown or just the final price per person, and whether the client sees confirmation codes and internal notes for each booking.
Duplicate proposals to present options (e.g. Economy vs. Premium) without redoing the work.
Every proposal moves from sent to accepted to paid; your client can accept it with one click from the same link you share, and we email you the moment they do.

resumen.texto: 1 to 15 agents · Up to 500 smart itineraries · Annual savings

simulador.titulo: This is what a proposal looks like for your client
simulador.texto: Try the switch to see how the view changes between the internal breakdown and the client-facing quote:

demo.incluye: Includes round-trip flights, 4 nights of boutique lodging, private transfers, cultural tours, and personalized assistance throughout the itinerary.

simulador.ayuda: 💡 In Rumbia you can switch between modes with a single toggle in the trip's settings.

planes.texto: Choose the billing frequency that best fits your operation. No forced contracts, no hidden fees:

inicio.texto: For independent advisors and small teams just getting started.
puntos: PDF with the advisor's contact info

agencia.texto: For growing travel agencies looking to standardize their sales.
puntos: **Logo, letterhead, and your own accent color** on the PDF
**Customizable typography and text size** on the PDF
**Hide price breakdown** (closed price to the client)

pro.texto: For established agencies with high volume and an extended team.
puntos: **Everything in the Agencia plan** (white label and custom color included)

planes.avisoStripe: 🔒 Payments processed 100% securely and encrypted by Stripe. Cancel or change plans anytime.

calculos.texto: Rumbia adds up and converts your costs automatically, in real time:

puntos.texto: Capture departures, arrivals, and booking confirmation codes.
Assign hotels to each city with automatic per-night calculation.
Record in dollars, euros, or local currency; the app unifies the total.
See how much the trip costs per individual traveler or for the whole group.
The agency subscription, handled securely through Stripe (PCI Level 1).
We don't charge extra fees for planning your trip.
Links take you to official providers (Booking, Skyscanner, Airbnb) where you or your client pay with no middleman.

ia.texto: Smart technology and advanced algorithms to optimize every step of your trip.

itinerarios.texto: Generate day-by-day routes with suggested activities, times, map coordinates, and estimated costs.

edicion.texto: Reorder and move activities between days with a mouse or touch gestures on mobile. Fully adjustable to your taste.

chatbot.texto: A floating assistant that knows your trip's details: ask it about routes, weather, or suggestions and get an instant answer, backed by general AI knowledge — it doesn't do a live lookup with providers, so confirm prices and availability on a real comparison site.

crm.titulo: Organize your work, don't repeat it
crm.texto: For when it's no longer just one trip, but several clients and proposals at once.

clientes.texto: Save each client's contact info and notes, link them to their trips and quotes, and find them again when they come back to you.

plantillas.texto: Build a template itinerary once ("Cancun all-inclusive", "Europe route") and apply it to each new client instead of starting from scratch.

multiDestino.texto: Add extra stops to a single trip, each with its own dates, weather, and itinerary.

cta.texto: Try an AI-generated itinerary for free, no account needed, or sign up for full control of your trips and quotes.
cta.generarSinCuenta: Generate an itinerary without an account

pie.aviso: Rumbia doesn't process trip bookings or payments. Links take you to the provider's site.
